snippet.title: ΚΟΤΑ - official trailer
snippet.description:
17 Σεπτεμβρίου 2026 στα Village Cinemas.

«Όσο μεγαλύτερη η δύναμη τόσο μεγαλύτερη η ευθύνη» — αλλά τι γίνεται στην περίπτωση που η ηρωίδα είναι μια κότα;
Αφού δραπετεύει από μια φάρμα, μια κότα βρίσκει καταφύγιο στην αυλή ενός υπό διάλυση εστιατορίου. Εκεί, ανακαλύπτει τον έρωτα, έρχεται αντιμέτωπη με την ιεραρχία της ομάδας και παλεύει να προστατεύσει τα αυγά της από έναν άπληστο ιδιοκτήτη. Η αστεία αλλά και συγκινητική αναζήτηση της μητρότητας από μια κότα αντικατοπτρίζει σε επίπεδο συμβολικό τους συμβιβασμούς και τους σιωπηλούς αγώνες της ανθρώπινης ζωής.

snippet.title: EGO 2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Besimi tronditet kur zbulon se nusja e ardhshme e djalit të tij është pikërisht vajza që ai kishte operuar fshehurazi, për të mbuluar një të kaluar që askush nuk duhej ta mësonte.

Kur Xhulia i rrëfen se pas këtij sekreti fshihet Lalani, trafikanti që e kishte dhunuar dhe që tashmë ndodhet në burg, Besimi i kërkon t’i tregojë Minos të vërtetën — ndërsa vetë hesht për sekretin që e lidh me të.

Nga qelia, Lalani nis një lojë hakmarrjeje të pamëshirshme. Një plan i përpiktë, që pas sulmit ndaj Xhulias, e bën edhe Besimin të dyshojë se autori mund të jetë vetë djali i tij.

EGO 2 është një thriller i fuqishëm ku e vërteta, faji dhe hakmarrja përplasen në një kurth që mund të shkatërrojë një familje të tërë.

🎬 Në kast:
Bujar Asqeriu, Raimonda Bulku, Zamira Kita, Sejfulla Myftari, Laert Vasili, Drilon Hoxha, Dritan Boriçi, Gjergj Doçi, Xhulia Musagalliu, si dhe shumë emra të tjerë të njohur të kinematografisë shqiptare.

Sometimes you don't need to explain yourself.
You don't need to be stronger.
You don't need to carry everything.

Sometimes you just need space.

“Let Me Breathe” is a powerful Luxury Soulful Afro House journey about breaking away from pressure, expectations, and the weight of always trying to be everything for everyone.

We spend so much of our lives saying yes.
Giving more.
Carrying more.
Trying to keep everyone happy.

Until one day, we realize we've forgotten to listen to ourselves.

This song is about that moment.

The moment you stop apologizing for needing space.
The moment you understand that choosing yourself isn't selfish.
The moment you finally hear your own heartbeat again.

You don't have to run.
You don't have to fight.

Let yourself breathe.
